required_components.source: Native m480 body, ragged green loincloth, long claws and belly.

G2.notes: Native body differs deliberately: upper arm 1.47x, hand 1.44x and neck-head span 2.03x the human source, normalized by height. Mesh-fitted source frames and solved grip handle these differences.

G3.notes: Actual irregular-club grip, native three-finger anatomy and source-frame fitted skeleton verified through all roles.

notes: All eight selected reduced-mesh clips pass 120 Hz limb/club checks at 2 mm threshold, after final Running free-arm correction to 50 degrees.
Three loop surface errors below 0.06 mm; Death/Dead equal; no source-relative angular continuity flags.
Upper wrap lies under belly; visible hem stays clear. Attack maximum club reach at native 1.0 seconds.
Delivered export parity below 0.021 mm. Actual 16 normal/half-speed browser recordings, sampled sequences and targeted close views reviewed.

G7.notes: Three tiers, eight roles, colour/shadow LODs and separate club installed. Focused regression passes; two unrelated MM8 asset failures recorded separately.

validation_limitations: Two unrelated MM8 actor regression failures (Cleric Attack and Dragon Turtle tiers).
No Vulkan, Android or performance validation.
